owner: Taxonomy Mappers + CEO-A Parts OS General Manager
purpose: Map repeated EU seller marketplace category patterns into canonical Parts Seller OS categories without copying any platform taxonomy verbatim.
principle: External labels are learning signals. Canonical categories are our own normalized operational categories.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: lighting / lights / feux / headlight / tail light
category_patterns.qa_rule: Block listing when side or front/rear position is missing for side-sensitive lamps.
Mechanical engine parts require condition/test note before publish.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: body / bumper / bonnet / fender / door / exterior body
category_patterns.qa_rule: Block vague 'other body part' style listing until exact part function is named.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: electronics / control unit / sensors / switches / wiring
category_patterns.qa_rule: Code-sensitive electronics cannot be sell_ready without OEM/code and fitment confidence.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: interior / seats / dashboard / belts / airbags / trim
category_patterns.qa_rule: Safety parts require stronger condition and compatibility notes.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: brake / ABS / brake booster / parking brake
category_patterns.qa_rule: ABS/brake sensors and modules need code/position confirmation before publish.

category_patterns.external_pattern_group: cooling / radiator / fan / heating / air conditioning
category_patterns.qa_rule: Radiators and AC components need leak/condition notes before high-confidence listing.

next_actions: Add mappings from B-Parts and Autoparts24 once verified.
Add language aliases for PL, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL and LT seller sources.
Wire category QA rules into Parts Seller OS add-part workflow.
